sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Use *hány*? when asking for a number or quantity. The exact context tells you what number is wanted.

hány? is the all-purpose ‘how many / what number’ word — it doesn’t change shape depending on what’s being counted, unlike English, which sometimes swaps in ‘how much.’ Whenever a question is fundamentally about a number, reach for hány? and let context fill in the rest — Hány éves vagy? literally asks ‘how many years are you.’
